_comment: Fragment to merge into the Firebase RTDB security rules (console-managed; there is no full rules file in the repo). cms_stories_index is the slim public read-model for the hot list/build surfaces — one record per published story carrying only the ~17 card/hero/whisper scalars (see app/lib/storyIndex.js). World-readable because /public-library, the category pages, search and the gateway/voices builds read it unauthenticated. Writable only by admin: it is maintained by the atomic dual-write in app/admin/page.js (every publish/edit/unpublish/delete writes cms_stories AND cms_stories_index in one multi-path update) and re-populated by scripts/backfill-stories-index.mjs. The .indexOn matches app/lib/voices.js:loadWorks, which now runs its equalTo(authorUid)/equalTo(author) queries against THIS node instead of the full cms_stories: authorUid is the identity match, author backs the matchNames fallback for rows saved with no uid.
